Canada oil pipeline approval faces potential legal challenge

Mark Carney is aiming for final approval of a new Canadian oil pipeline by 2027, a move that faces potential legal challenges from First Nations groups. British Columbia Premier David Eby stated that his government has an important role to play in the process.
